scope: Existing macOS/iOS-simulator/Android-emulator runners re-executed before the BaroChart rename. Simulator/emulator only: no physical device, no display FPS claim.

macos.note: 10 new checks execute compactData, translateDrawings, deleteDrawings, setIndicatorParamsAsync and restoreWorkspaceAsync on JavaScriptCore for the first time

runs.note: includes the new VoiceOver escape check

runs.command: npm run build:ios:ingestion && npm run test:ios:ingestion -- --pilot
runs.note: first pilot failed once (see findings); passed on rerun

runs.command: npm run build:ios:mobile-ux && npm run test:ios:mobile-ux
npm run build:apple:transactions && npm run test:apple:transactions

runs.note: AAR audit passes; Java now compiled with -Xlint:all,-options -Werror
recent-API checks execute the five recent Java APIs on JNI/QuickJS for the first time

runs.command: ASTER_INGESTION_CORE_SHA=<current core> npm run build:android:ingestion && npm run test:android:ingestion
npm run build:android:mobile-ux && npm run test:android:mobile-ux

findings.summary: BaroChart UIKit view ignored the VoiceOver escape gesture (accessibilityPerformEscape returned false), leaving an active drawing gesture and pointer. The cycle-12 ingestion pilot exposed it intermittently when its drawing check overlapped an XCUI drag.
findings.fix: accessibilityPerformEscape now performs the existing 'Cancel interaction' action; examples/ios/App.swift checks it (RED: escaped=false pointers=1 gesture=create, GREEN after fix).

findings.summary: AAR Java compile carried two hidden deprecation warnings (ComponentCallbacks.onLowMemory, TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_LOW).
findings.fix: Method-level suppression with the minSdk 26 reason; AAR build now uses -Xlint:all,-options with -Werror so new lint warnings fail the build.

environmentRequirements: Kotlin consumer runners build offline from ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2, so the cache needs one online build of examples/kotlin-* first.
Hover/mobile-UX runners only accept serial emulator-5580 with a private adb server on port 5038; the ingestion runner also requires AVD name aster-validation.
build:android:ingestion pins a historical core SHA; validating the current bundle requires ASTER_INGESTION_CORE_SHA set to its SHA-256.
test:ios:ingestion defaults to a 900 s run that needs --quiet-go; --pilot runs the 60 s functional mode.
test-ios-ingestion does not remove an existing pilot.xcresult; a rerun needs it removed first.
